description: This file defines the ElasticsearchApiController class, which handles API requests related to Elasticsearch queries within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It includes methods for querying content and documents via HTTP GET and POST, with authorization checks and query execution logic.

classes.name: ElasticsearchApiController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for Elasticsearch queries, including content and document searches with authorization checks.

methods.name: Content
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve content based on query parameters, with authorization.

methods.name: ContentPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve content based on query parameters, with authorization.

methods.name: Documents
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve documents based on query parameters, with authorization.

methods.name: DocumentsPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve documents based on query parameters, with authorization.

methods.name: ElasticQueryApiAsync
methods.description: Executes an Elasticsearch query asynchronously based on the provided query model and options.
